title: ValueAndPulseRules
pulseMeaning: Activity feedback and measurement across work, resource/compute consumption, value and transfer velocity.

variables.V_created: Total recognized value created in the measurement window
variables.C_consumed: Total recognized compute and operational cost in the measurement window
variables.N_active_agents: Number of active state-valid HAPI agents in the measurement scope

referenceEquation.rule: The reference equation is a model, not constitutional truth. Domain, jurisdiction and empirical calibration may require a versioned amendment.

measurementRules: Compute and operational cost must be measured on a documented basis.
Value recognition requires an applicable value/evidence contract.
Pulse is separated from raw telemetry.
Pulse may trigger a governed operational response but cannot bypass authority or policy.
A negative Pulse signal is not by itself proof of misconduct or insolvency.
